review_candidates.title: Sound System Site Engineer | Fresh Graduates
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Assist senior engineers in troubleshooting, diagnosing, and resolving technical issues related to sound systems and audio equipment. Maintain and organize audio equipment, tools, cables, and inventory. Support system commissioning, testing, and on-site technical requirements. Basic technical knowledge of audio systems, installation, configuration, and troubleshooting.
eligibility_evidence: Job Accountabilities: Assist in the setup, configuration, calibration, testing, and maintenance of audio equipment for live events, installations, and on-site demonstrations.
Support system commissioning, testing, and on-site technical requirements.
Provide on-site technical support during events, installations, demonstrations, and project implementations as required.
Willingness to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and on-site assignments when required for events and installations.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: You will work closely with senior engineers, gaining hands-on technical experience and developing your expertise in professional audio systems. Support system commissioning, testing, and on-site technical requirements. Ability and willingness to learn and develop technical expertise.
